caption: Monthly plans: Starter $15 (500 pages), Basic $25 (2,000) and Advanced $40 (5,000), each with a 14 day trial. We stayed on the Free plan; the store name is hidden.
The first scan scored our products between 60% and 75%, with Bundle Product #1 lowest at 60% and 5 suggestions. A presenter photo and the store name are hidden.

For Bundle Product #1 the app flagged a 17 character title, an empty description and alt text problems, and offered an AI title (Regenerate 1/3). The proposal ended in our store name and is hidden, as are the preview address and store name.
Starter on the annual tab comes to $144 a year, due in full on 1 Dec after the trial; Approve stayed grey without a payment method and we did not approve. The store name is hidden.
After we saved the AI title the Activity log still read No record found, so the change was not logged. The store name is hidden.
After saving the AI title, Bundle Product #1 rose from 60% to 65% and from 5 to 4 suggestions; the other products stayed the same. A presenter photo and the store name are hidden.
